jobs.title: Compliance Agent (Legal Account Restriction)
jobs.description:
When a legal claim hits Eva’s money, she needs to understand what’s happening and what it means for her, quickly and clearly. As our Legal Account Restrictions Agent, you handle those cases: you carry out garnishments, bankruptcies, and guardianships correctly, and you explain them to Eva calmly, in plain language.

Up for this? Kick off your application by taking our assessment and find out if bunq is your perfect match! ⚖️

Take ownership

As our Legal Account Restrictions Agent, you’ll run your cases with minimal supervision.

  • Process garnishment, bankruptcy, and guardianship cases accurately and on time, following the legal requirements for each ✅

  • Decide routine cases that are unclear on your own, and know when to escalate the rest 🧭

  • Answer Eva when she reaches out about a restricted account, and explain what is happening without legal jargon 💬

  • Handle formal complaints with care and accuracy 📝

  • Use AI to work faster and more accurately, spot when an answer is wrong, and give feedback as our processes evolve 🤖

  • You work carefully and accurately, even when the queue is busy

  • You can explain a complicated legal situation calmly and clearly to someone who is stressed

  • You make sound decisions when legal information is incomplete or unclear, and you know when to ask for a second opinion

  • You’re structured and keep your accuracy high when the pace picks up

  • You’re comfortable using AI tools and checking what they produce

  • You speak English fluently and you’re available for weekend shifts

  • Knowledge of garnishment, bankruptcy, or guardianship is a plus, but we’ll train you

Curious to see how we make life easy? - try the bunq app, it only takes 5 minutes to sign up.

Your space to perform

We give you the space and the tools you need to succeed 💪🏼

🤟 Great, international colleagues who share your mindset

👩‍💻 Hybrid setup: after 3 months in-office, work 2 days remote, 3 days in-office weekly.

📚 We support growth with bunq Academy and €1500 annual learning budget

🚴‍♀️ A Multisport gym card for your health and wellbeing

🚌 Travel expenses are covered whether you come walking or by bike, bus or car (though we prefer green choices 🌳)

🧳 Digital Nomad Program: After your first year, enjoy up to 20 days per year to work while traveling, combining flexibility with strong team collaboration

🚀 We reward tenure with a dedicated travel budget: €1.5k after 2 years and €3k after 4 years to visit another core office.

💻 A MacBook so you can Get Shit Done with us

🥦 Delicious lunches from our fabulous in-house chefs with vegan and vegetarian options

⚕️ Private health insurance, just in case

💸 Monthly contribution to your phone and internet bills

🍻 Friday drinks and other celebrations - bunq style

All new hires are subject to Pre-employment Screening (PES), which includes checks conducted by our third-party partner, Zinc. This is part of our commitment to a secure and trustworthy workplace.

jobs.title: (Senior) Copywriter
jobs.description:
At bunq, we’re on a mission to Make Life Easy for our users by creating the most user-centric banking experience out there. Every email, push notification and in-app message we send should feel like it was written for the person reading it, not for us. Right now, nobody owns that.

That’s where you come in. As our Copywriter, you will own every message our users get across email, push and in-app, plus the updates they read when something goes wrong. AI will write most of the first drafts. You’ll build the system that writes them, judge what it gets wrong, and add the creative edge AI always misses.

Take Ownership 🚀

You’ll own the words our users read every day. Here’s how you’ll do it:

  • Build, maintain and improve AI copywriting agents for email, push and in-app, and feed your edits back in so their output keeps getting better.

  • Turn every draft into copy that starts from the user’s world, not ours (“your rate just jumped to 3.01%” instead of “we increased your rate”), with hooks, subject lines and tone that make people act.

  • Own the moments that matter most, from the messages users see before they leave to incident banners and status page updates, and write the one-off copy the system can’t produce.

  • Your English is fluent at a professional level, and your grammar and spelling are spotless. Native or near-native is a plus.

  • You’ve built or improved AI agents or prompts that produce copy, and you know how to fix them when the output drifts.

  • You write creative, user-first copy that gets people to open, click and act.

  • You’ve turned briefs into finished copy across multiple channels, on time. Lifecycle or CRM experience is a bonus.

  • You’re reachable outside working hours when our users need to be informed of an ongoing incident.

jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.description:
At bunq, we’re on a mission to Make Life Easy for our users by creating the most user-centric banking experience out there. That starts with keeping their data safe. As AI makes attackers faster, we’re seeing more critical zero-day vulnerabilities than ever, and we need to stay ahead of them.

That’s where you come in. As our Security Engineer, you’ll own how 700 colleagues get secure access to our systems, and you’ll help defend bunq against attacks as they happen. You’ll design and build security processes that AI can’t run on its own, and automate everything that it can.

Take Ownership 🚀

You’ll keep bunq secure, from access control to incident response. Here’s how you’ll do it:

  • Own access control governance in Okta Identity Governance, automating how access is granted, revoked and reviewed, so every employee and contractor has the right access from day one.

  • Investigate and triage security incidents and vulnerability findings, decide whether they’re malicious, and escalate or fix them fast.

  • Drive the replacement of our security monitoring system with an AI-based platform that detects and stops threats automatically, and build automations so the team can focus on real security issues.

  • You’ve worked hands-on as a security engineer, investigating and triaging security incidents.

  • You write code to automate security work, not just to run scripts.

  • You’ve worked with identity governance and know how to build secure login and access solutions.

  • You communicate clearly with stakeholders, especially under pressure when someone is locked out or an incident hits.

  • You bring engineering experience. Consultancy experience alone isn’t the right fit.
